Hey! I'm Nazeeh.
(pronounced /nə-'ziː/, like "Na-zee")

When I'm not coding, you'll find me watching Formula 1, traveling the world, or capturing moments through my camera. I also create video tutorials and vlogs to share what I learn and experience.
